name: Toenail
desc: The little hard shield at the tip of each toe - the one the bath softens and the clippers trim each week.
prose: You are a toenail - the small hard shield at the end of each toe, tucked down in the dark of the sock all day. You grow slow and need a trim, and you go a funny pink in the bath. Stub the toe and it is you that takes the knock. Children paint you bright colours in summer when the sandals come out. Little, tough, and easy to forget - that is you, ten of you down at the very bottom of things.

lines: The hard front bone of your lower leg,
you bash it on the table edge -
A wide-mouthed cone that narrows down,
you pour the sand right through;
it fills the bottle with no spill -
The little round bone at the front of the knee,
it slides as the leg bends;
you graze it falling off your bike -
A small shy flower of deepest purple,
it shares its name with the colour too -
